name: Wit of Gutter’s Reprisal
body:
School transmutation; Level: jester 9

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of combat, each time you are hit by an attack made by an enemy, you gain a +4 bonus to attack rolls with spells with the Jest keyword against that enemy until the end of your next turn.
